sentence: This project studies how losing DNA methylation leads to DNA breaks and genome instability in cancer cells.
This project builds tests and deep learning tools that measure a protein in breast tumors and where it sits in the tissue.
This project studies how antibodies pass from pregnant women to their babies after COVID-19 infection or COVID-19 mRNA vaccines.
This project studies how abnormal lipid metabolism affects the cells and functions of the mouse intervertebral disc.
This project builds a robot that works with MRI to treat brain tumors by thermal ablation and biopsy.
This project studies what controls the fate of stem cells in the periosteum and the paratenon, using animal models.
This project supports research on cancer prevention and control across several fields.
This project tries to find out which features of the oral bacterium Treponema denticola make it cause disease.
This project studies how related proteins that guide body patterning lead cells to diverse fates, using stem cells, imaging and machine learning.
This project studies how four RNA-mediated machineries work, to build tools for cancer treatment, genome manipulation and virus detection.
This project builds computational methods that use genetic data sampled over time to show how natural selection shapes evolution.
This project builds tools that use peptides to switch specific target proteins on or off.
This project studies how raised intraocular pressure affects the shape and perfusion of the optic nerve head in glaucoma.
This project builds a way to engineer regulatory T cells so they keep their identity as regulatory T cells.
This project studies how neurons keep their mitochondria healthy and well distributed, using the Drosophila visual system.
This project provides light and electron microscopy imaging and analysis for vision research.
This project studies how certain kidney cells sense and respond to potassium and sodium changes in the diet.
This project uses AI and lab experiments to study how alternative splicing changes RNA-binding proteins and may contribute to disease.
This project studies how tumors, their surroundings and the immune system interact, to help develop cancer treatments.
This project develops a gene editing approach that uses a virus to repair mutations in a gene that cause Rett Syndrome.
